issues.description: The solution declares the Farm.animals field as public (public List<Animal> animals;), while the problem statement UML and the template instructions indicate that animals should be a private attribute with a getter and setter. This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the intended encapsulation and the expectation to implement accessor methods.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the animals attribute private in the solution (private List<Animal> animals;) and keep the public getter and setter. Alternatively, update the problem statement and template to explicitly allow a public field if that is intended. The preferred fix is to use private visibility to match the UML and the instructions to implement getter/setter.
